name: map3d (real-world 3D city maps to GLB)
summary: Open-source React-Three-Fiber app that turns OpenStreetMap data into 3D buildings and roads for any area and exports them as GLB, usable as blockout for games, digital twins or drone/GPS scenes. Free hosted version at map.fleet.im; MIT code you can self-host.

access.notes: Code is MIT. Exported maps are derived from OpenStreetMap data (ODbL): credit OpenStreetMap contributors. Heights can be missing or wrong (README). No building textures yet.

procedure: Open https://map.fleet.im (no account), pick an area and generate the 3D buildings and roads.
Export the scene as GLB and import it into Blender, Unity, Godot or three.js.
To self-host, download https://github.com/cartesiancs/map3d/archive/refs/heads/main.zip and run the React app.
Credit OpenStreetMap contributors in your project.

verdict.why: Free, no-account OSM-to-GLB city generator with MIT code and 2.6k stars; quick real-world blockouts. Older project (2025, last push May 2026) resurfaced today; OSM data needs attribution and heights can be inaccurate.
